overview: A transaction row that opens to show the items that compose its amount, such as the gross amount and the fees of a sale.

collapsed.title: Collapsed
collapsed.text: Default. The row shows the total and a chevron. It is controlled: keep `expanded` in your state and update it in `onToggle`.

expanded.title: Expanded
expanded.text: `expanded` shows the child items on a timeline and the `supportingText` below them. Use Child Read Only or Child Action as children, with `position` set on each.

rules: Use Expandable only when the amount is made of parts people need to check.
Control the state: pass `expanded` and update it in `onToggle`.
Use only Child Read Only and Child Action as children, and set `position` on every child.
Set `content.size` and `amount.size` so the row aligns with the other rows of the list.

api.expanded: Shows the child items. Controlled: use it with `onToggle`.
api.onToggle: Called with the next state when the row is toggled.
api.children: Child items shown when expanded, with `position` set on each.
api.supportingText: Text below the child items, when expanded.
api.type: Container: `card` or `text` for a continuous list.
